import pandas as pd

# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/8942/1_8942_init.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)

# Read the sheets
df_overview = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Overview')
df_pay_dates = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Pay Dates')

# The instruction says: "If I choose January 29 from the data validation in A2 I want B5 to calculate all the monthly pay checks in January from the 'Pay Dates' worksheet."
# Let's identify the date in A2 of the Overview sheet.
# Based on the provided content:
# Overview sheet:
# 0  2016-01-29 00:00:00      1000.0       1000.0
# This means A2 (index 0 in pandas if header is row 1) is 2016-01-29.
selected_date = df_overview.iloc[0, 0]

# Convert to datetime to extract month and year
selected_date = pd.to_datetime(selected_date)
month = selected_date.month
year = selected_date.year

# Convert Pay Dates 'Date' column to datetime
df_pay_dates['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_pay_dates['Date'])

# Filter Pay Dates for the same month and year
mask = (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.month == month) & (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.year == year)
january_paychecks = df_pay_dates[mask]

# Calculate the total of all paychecks (Paycheck 1 + Paycheck 2) for that month
total_monthly = january_paychecks['Paycheck 1'].sum() + january_paychecks['Paycheck 2'].sum()

# The target cell is B5 on the 'Overview' sheet.
# In the provided data extent: rows 1-5, cols A-C.
# Row 1: Header
# Row 2: Index 0 (Date, Paycheck 1, Paycheck 2)
# Row 3: Index 1 (NaN, NaN, NaN)
# Row 4: Index 2 (Total Bi Weekly ..., 2000.0, NaN)
# Row 5: Index 3 (Total Monthly ..., NaN, NaN)
# So B5 corresponds to row index 3, column index 1 (B).

# Update the value in the dataframe
df_overview.iloc[3, 1] = total_monthly

# Save the modified spreadsheet
with pd.ExcelWriter('/mnt/data/outputs/8942_0_01e69ecd/1_8942_output.xlsx', engine='openpyxl') as writer:
    df_overview.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Overview', index=False)
    df_pay_dates.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Pay Dates', index=False)

print(f"Calculated total: {total_monthly}")
